No red-screen errors. Only carried-over cosmetic RN-web warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents). No new deprecated Expo packages detected.

issues: RN-web deprecation warnings persist (shadow*/pointerEvents) — cosmetic, carried over from prior iterations.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius still present on RN-web. Cosmetic only. Migrate to boxShadow. Reference: multiple files in /app/frontend/app/*.tsx.

action_items: OPTIONAL cosmetic (carried over): migrate shadow* → boxShadow across StyleSheet blocks; migrate pointerEvents prop → style.pointerEvents.

OPTIONAL UX: Advanced Scan requires connection state; on a hard-reload to /advanced-scan the simulation provider hasn't auto-connected yet and an Alert fires. Consider auto-triggering simulation connect on mount of shared diagnostics screens or showing an in-page 'Connecting…' skeleton for a beat instead of blocking with an Alert. Not blocking — in-app navigation works fine.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1199 diagnostics_interpret — Prompts differentiate module vs system with proper bold-labeled section templates; graceful 500 on GPT failure. Session_id includes user id + kind + title[:12] for isolation. Good.

server.py:1246 create_scan — Persists modules/dtcs/readiness/systems/metrics/overall_score + workflow title mapping. If GPT fails, falls back to 'AI report unavailable. Review the structured results below.' (still 200 with ai_report string) — great UX contract; frontend never sees a broken doc.
server.py:1279 list_scans — Uses {"modules":0,"systems":0} projection to keep payloads small on list; user_id + optional vehicle_id filter; sorted desc by created_at limit 100. Correct.
server.py:1291 get_scan/delete_scan — Both scoped by user_id (auth-safe); get returns 404 when not found (verified in tests).

server.py: file is now 1317 lines — well beyond the 700-line advisory limit. Recommend splitting into modules (auth, vehicles, intelligence, diagnostics/scans) — carried over from iter-7; not blocking.
advanced-scan.tsx:35 — start() Alert.alert on !connected: on web this becomes a blocking window.alert. Consider a non-blocking inline banner + auto-connect kick. Minor UX.

ecu-modules.tsx:74 — testID sits on outer View but the tap target is inner Pressable (cardTop). Works when tapping the visual card top area; automated testing needs to target the inner Pressable. Consider hoisting testID onto the Pressable or wrapping the whole card in a single Pressable.
scan-report.tsx:144 — report-export gracefully handles web via informational Alert per spec. Good.
All new screens honor safe-area insets, use StyleSheet.create, wrap text in <Text>, and expose testIDs on every interactive element as required by the code-review guidelines.
